notes: Restores regressed staff workflows from the launchable desktop application, including Intake Dashboard Delete Form, reports coverage, intake search, and intake DOB/phone auto-formatting.
Restores the redesigned Mass Email Youth workflow with Programs selection and searchable Event selection for large event lists.
Fixes public Send to Youth intake packet rendering so youth see the form fields, and keeps completed submissions merged into existing youth profiles and Youth Log intake completion.
Restores phone/tablet Event Attendance by using authenticated staff event-signup endpoints instead of unauthorized client-app routes.
Adds Services Requested vs Received Raw and Youth Service Log reporting support, plus All Youth vs Current Youth Only report scoping.
Keeps HMIS ID as the visible youth identifier and keeps Profile ID hidden from day-to-day table views where staff do not need it.
